answer: Plant threshold bait. Each epoch the network splits a cipher key into shares sent to random seats; any five rebuild it and unlock a pot. Handing a share to a stranger only lets that stranger claim, so honest agents keep theirs. An operator running many seats watches shares pool like a river and is tempted to cash out, but redeeming proves one party held five seats, so their locked balances are forfeited and the whole plume of linked accounts is cut.
